slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize total weekly profit, or is it to find any production plan that simply meets the minimum profit of 3000 yuan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether the objective is to maximize total weekly profit, which fully covers the hidden objective-function slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time, unused capacity, or any secondary objective weighted by process hourly costs. It only confirmed profit maximization.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize profit; there is no secondary requirement to minimize idle time of manufacturing, assembly, and inspection with weights proportional to process costs.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle-time minimization or a multi-objective formulation, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit maximization as the objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved H1 but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL without ever asking about the P1 hidden idle-time minimization objective.

summary: The agent correctly recovered the profit-maximization objective and several constraints, but it failed to probe the secondary idle-time minimization requirement. It stopped with an unresolved P1 hidden slot and silently assumed profit maximization was the only objective.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
